title: The wrong rook pawn
line: Bishop and rook pawn draw when the bishop cannot cover the corner.

steps.text: This bishop runs on light squares, but the pawn promotes on a dark corner. The bishop can never drive the king out of it.
With the black king in the corner, the game is a draw, a whole bishop and pawn up.
You have Black. Head for the corner.

steps.text: Now you have White, with the move. Keep the black king out of the corner.

also.h5h6: That works too: the pawn runs, and a bishop check keeps the black king away. This lesson goes with the king.

steps.hint: Step your king toward the corner, ahead of the black king.
steps.after: The black king cannot get near the corner, and the pawn promotes.

summary: A rook pawn with a bishop that cannot cover the corner is a draw once the defending king gets there.
